cohort: 201 patients attempting a VBAC delivery at a single center from January 2012 to June 2014
finding: The MFMU VBAC calculator was less accurate for patients with scores in the 40-80% decile range and underestimated success in White and Hispanic patients.
mod_finding: The MFMU VBAC calculator underestimated the success of VBAC in the mid-decile range and in White and Hispanic patients.
